text:
elaine: quick heads-up — during the v2 quiet cutover (canary-3) we saw a brief spike of 503s affecting tenant-42.

deploybot: deploybot noticed: v2 rollout step canary-3 started by maria at 2026-03-21T02:03:00Z; routing split 10% -> v2.

james: logs show a high 503 rate on gateway-for-tenant-42, stack indicates header lookup failed in downstream auth: `getHeader('x-client-version')` returned null.

priya: ah — release notes mentioned we canonicalize header case on the new proxy but only for `x-api-version`. Did we add `x-client-version` to that list?

elaine: i don't think so, we only normalized the api-version header. client-version was left as-is to avoid touching client-supplied metadata.

tom: can we avoid a full rollback? suggestion: pin tenant-42 to v1 while we add a shim in v2 to accept both header cases.

maria: /deploybot pin tenant tenant-42 v1 — planning to pin until fix lands.

deploybot: command accepted. tenant-42 pinned to v1. Will exclude from v2 routing and notify operators.

ops-bot: metrics snapshot (1m):
```
gateway-503-rate: tenant-42 = 7.4% (baseline 0.1%)
other-tenants-canary = 0.2%
error-source = header-mismatch -> auth-service
```

james: confirming — 503s are concentrated on `auth-service` when header lookup returns undefined, hitting a code-path that throws. quick patch would check both `x-client-version` and `X-Client-Version` and fallback.

priya: i'll open a tiny PR for the shim, target branch `release/v2-compat-shim`, mark for hotfix. Expected deploy in the next canary push (ETA ~30m).

elaine: sounds good. decision: pin affected tenants -> no global rollback. continue canary for others but hold further increases in v2 traffic until shim verified.

maria: updating release notes + internal changelog to call out header-canonicalization change and migration tips for clients. Will add a note under "breaking changes?" section and link to suggested shim.

tom: follow-up ops item: add automated guard to detect header-normalization regressions in preflight checks — alert if any tenant 503 > 1% in 5m during rollout.

priya: PR created: https://git.redwood/release/v2-compat-shim/pull/12 — includes unit test for header variants.

deploybot: deploy scheduled for canary-4 in ~28 minutes. Will only include shim, no other behavioral changes.

james: once canary-4 confirmed clean for 15m i'll unpin tenant-42. who's the operator to flip?

maria: i'll unpin and post follow-up here when done. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: quiet window for broad cutover is 23:00-03:00 UTC tonight; any unplanned rollbacks should be coordinated with oncall.

elaine: thanks everyone. action items: priya -> ship shim; maria -> update release notes and unpin when green; tom -> add preflight alert; james -> monitor auth logs. will keep thread updated. :eyes:

maria: unpinned tenant-42 from v1 at 2026-03-21T02:41:30Z after 20m of canary-4 with no spikes. all good.

elaine: verified downstream errors back to baseline. closing this thread, will file a follow-up retro note for the release playbook to mention header list coverage.
